game.name: Doom (Unity Ports)
game.rules:
# **Full game runs**

- Timing starts upon the frame the difficulty selection is no longer visible.
- Timing ends on first frame of the screen melt on the final level.
- Death starts are NOT allowed for full game/episode runs.
- Quick saving, then quick loading at the very beginning of a level to bypass the screen melt is not allowed

# **Individual Level Rules**

- The level must either be started via the level select menu, or through any other technique specifically described below.
- In the event there is no results screen, timing starts on first available input, and ends on first frame of screen melt.
- We have discovered that in the load menu, your save shows the information needed for verification. With that in mind, we have allowed for people to start their IL's on UV, and UV+ via a death save, loaded from the pause menu. To do this, simply load the desired map on the desired difficulty of UV or higher, die in the map, Pause, save, then click on the ? to show the save information, click back, click load, and load your death save.
*Note: This still means if a run on UV is loaded via a quicksave, or restarted after a death, it will still be rejected*
*Also note: This does NOT apply to the Nightmare difficulty, as there is a bug that disables fast pinkies when loading a save on that difficulty.*
- Quick saving on a death, and quick loading the IL for Any% is accepted. Similarly, dying and restarting the IL for Any% is accepted.
- Accidental quick saves during any IL is NOT allowed.
- Pausing during any IL is NOT allowed.
- When loading into the level, the initial screen melt must be shown ***in full***.

# **Cheat%**

- Complete the segment with use of cheat codes
- Use of typing in cheats on PC, including IDCLIP, or IDCLEV to warp levels is **NOT ALLOWED**, for fairness with console.
- Must use in-game menu
- Clicking 2 cheats on the same menu is not allowed

# **General Submission Rules**

- If runs being submitted to the leaderboard have commentary, it must follow TOS standards for most public access forums like Twitch. Submissions that have racial/sexist/hate commentary, visible/horrific imagery, or offensive materials to the general public, will result in a rejection.
- **Runs of any kind MUST show the messages in the top left in full**. If they are covered in any way, moderators may reject your run at their discretion. This also goes for anything on the HUD, whether it's your Health, Armor, Ammo count, etc. They are not to be covered.
- All episode runs/full game runs MUST show the results screen in full at the end of map 8/map 30. No Exceptions. If only the melt is shown, and no results screen, moderators may reject or verify at their own discretion.
- If a run uses remapped movement on a controller, or and off the walls form of input, it MUST be submitted under the correct input, such as controller remapped or Misc.
- Video submission is required for **ALL** runs
- Audio **MUST** be present and at a reasonable level in all top 5 full game runs as of 2/11/2022

categories.rules:
- Complete the Level on any of the first 3 difficulties.

*See Game Rules for a more extensive ruleset*

categories.name: UV
categories.rules:
- Complete the Level on Ultra-Violence.

*See Game Rules for a more extensive ruleset*

categories.name: UV-Max
categories.rules:
- Complete the Level on Ultra-Violence with 100% Kills and Secrets.

*See Game Rules for a more extensive ruleset*

categories.name: UV-Pacifist
categories.rules:
Complete the IL without harming or killing any demons, whether directly, or indirectly. The rules are as follow:

Telefrags allowed but only if unintentional (mods may decide at their discretion)

Harming enemies in any way, directly or indirectly (including environmental hazards such as barrels and deliberate use of crushers) is not allowed.

Note: If your run qualifies as a pacifist run, but would rather submit to the UV category, you are allowed to do so.

Ultra-Violence difficulty only

categories.name: UV+
categories.rules:
- Complete the Level on Ultra-Violence+.

*See Game Rules for a more extensive ruleset*

categories.name: Doom+Doom II
categories.rules:
**Complete Doom 1 Episodes 1-4, and Doom II.**
- Timing begins on difficulty selection.
- Timing ends on the first frame of the screen melting in the final level.
**General Rules**
- RTA only.
- Video proof of your run is required.
- Loading from a save at the start of the run is not allowed.
- Must show difficulty selection.

*See games rules for a more extensive rule list.*

categories.name: All Levels
categories.rules:
- For individual episodes, complete all 9 maps of the episode, including the secret map.

- For E1-E3, 4, and or 5, All maps must be completed including each episodes secret maps. 

- For Doom II, Plutonia, and TNT, All maps including maps 31 and 32 must be completed.

- For DII E2, Complete maps 11-20 of Doom II, with the inclusion of the secret maps 31 and 32. This means you must exit via the secret exit in map 15.

- For Master Levels, the secret map Bad Dream must be completed. You may access it from the level select menu.

- For No Rest for the Living, all maps including map 9 must be completed.

**General Rules**
- Run must start from the difficulty selection screen.
- Timing starts upon difficulty selection.
- Timing ends on first frame of the screen melt of the final map of whichever category you choose.
- RTA only.
- Video proof of your run is required.
- Loading from a save at the start of the run is not allowed.

*See games rules for a more extensive rule list.*

Telefrags allowed but only if unintentional (mods may decide at their discretion)

categories.name: NM-Slow (Archive)
categories.rules:
This is an archival category for times on Nightmare before Version 1.0.0.9.

Slower Pinkies.

Complete the Level on Nightmare

In Game Time is used for IL times.

If selecting the level from the menu, please include the full selection prior from the runs start.

Please keep the full submission in tact with the initial spawn, the full level run, and results screen included.

You MUST have a spawn from the initial entry of the level from the menu, or re-spawning after death.

Quick saving at the start of a level, or using quick saves at anytime in a submission for a personal best in game time result is not accepted. 

Using a quick load on the level, then dying to restart the level via re-spawning, is accepted.

categories.name: NMS-Max (Archival)
categories.rules:
This is an archival category for times on Nightmare before Version 1.0.0.9.

Slower Pinkies.

Complete the Level on Nightmare with 100% Kills and Secrets.

In Game Time is used for IL times.

If selecting the level from the menu, please include the full selection prior from the runs start.

Please keep the full submission in tact with the initial spawn, the full level run, and results screen included.

You MUST have a spawn from the initial entry of the level from the menu, or re-spawning after death.

Quick saving at the start of a level, or using quick saves at anytime in a submission for a personal best in game time result is not accepted. 

Using a quick load on the level, then dying to restart the level via re-spawning, is accepted.

categories.name: Cheat%
categories.rules:
Complete the segment with the use of cheats from the in-game menu.

**Cheat% Specific Rules**
- For fairness with console. All ports must use the in-game menu. This means for PC, typing in any cheats with the keyboard is **NOT** allowed. This includes IDCLEV, or any other form of level warping.
- For Master Levels, maps 1-20 must be played. You can choose them from either the new game section, or the level select, doesn't make a difference as long as all 20 maps are played in full and on the same difficulty.
- For Anthology, or multiple episode runs of any kind, the same difficulty MUST be used across all WAD's/Episodes.
- If doing the anthology category, the following WAD's must be played on the same difficulty:
 - Doom (E1-E5)
 - Doom II: Hell on Earth
 - Master Levels for Doom II
 - No Rest for the living
 - TNT: Evilution
 - The Plutonia Experiment.

- Timing begins on difficulty select for the WAD you choose to start with.
- Timing ends on the first frame of the screen melting in the final level of the final WAD played.

**General Rules**
- RTA only.
- Video proof of your run is required.
- Loading from a save at the start of the run is not allowed.
- Must show difficulty selection.

*See games rules for a more extensive rule list.*

games.name: Doom (Unity Ports)
games.rules:
# **Full game runs**

- Timing starts upon the frame the difficulty selection is no longer visible.
- Timing ends on first frame of the screen melt on the final level.
- Death starts are NOT allowed for full game/episode runs.
- Quick saving, then quick loading at the very beginning of a level to bypass the screen melt is not allowed

# **Individual Level Rules**

- The level must either be started via the level select menu, or through any other technique specifically described below.
- In the event there is no results screen, timing starts on first available input, and ends on first frame of screen melt.
- We have discovered that in the load menu, your save shows the information needed for verification. With that in mind, we have allowed for people to start their IL's on UV, and UV+ via a death save, loaded from the pause menu. To do this, simply load the desired map on the desired difficulty of UV or higher, die in the map, Pause, save, then click on the ? to show the save information, click back, click load, and load your death save.
*Note: This still means if a run on UV is loaded via a quicksave, or restarted after a death, it will still be rejected*
*Also note: This does NOT apply to the Nightmare difficulty, as there is a bug that disables fast pinkies when loading a save on that difficulty.*
- Quick saving on a death, and quick loading the IL for Any% is accepted. Similarly, dying and restarting the IL for Any% is accepted.
- Accidental quick saves during any IL is NOT allowed.
- Pausing during any IL is NOT allowed.
- When loading into the level, the initial screen melt must be shown ***in full***.

# **Cheat%**

- Complete the segment with use of cheat codes
- Use of typing in cheats on PC, including IDCLIP, or IDCLEV to warp levels is **NOT ALLOWED**, for fairness with console.
- Must use in-game menu
- Clicking 2 cheats on the same menu is not allowed

# **General Submission Rules**

- If runs being submitted to the leaderboard have commentary, it must follow TOS standards for most public access forums like Twitch. Submissions that have racial/sexist/hate commentary, visible/horrific imagery, or offensive materials to the general public, will result in a rejection.
- **Runs of any kind MUST show the messages in the top left in full**. If they are covered in any way, moderators may reject your run at their discretion. This also goes for anything on the HUD, whether it's your Health, Armor, Ammo count, etc. They are not to be covered.
- All episode runs/full game runs MUST show the results screen in full at the end of map 8/map 30. No Exceptions. If only the melt is shown, and no results screen, moderators may reject or verify at their own discretion.
- If a run uses remapped movement on a controller, or and off the walls form of input, it MUST be submitted under the correct input, such as controller remapped or Misc.
- Video submission is required for **ALL** runs
- Audio **MUST** be present and at a reasonable level in all top 5 full game runs as of 2/11/2022
